    Poset configurations in a ray table (Lemmas 8.9 and C.1) #

    A configuration of a finite poset Q in a ray table: objects (v a, g a) of the graded covering category, and rays ρ a b for a ≤ b of weight g b - g a, composing as the poset. The retraction conditions say that a selected ray never factors as a selected arrow times a non-selected morphism (on either side); they are required only for cover relations of Q (the arrows of its Hasse diagram, lem:representation-transfer, lem:tree-quotient). Then the incidence algebra of Q is representation-finite when kP is.

    Type

    A configuration of a finite poset in the graded covering category.

    • v : Q → V
    • g : Q → L
    • ρ (a b : Q) : a ≤ b → R
    • src_ρ (a b : Q) (h : a ≤ b) : P.src (self.ρ a b h) = self.v a
    • tgt_ρ (a b : Q) (h : a ≤ b) : P.tgt (self.ρ a b h) = self.v b
    • wt_ρ (a b : Q) (h : a ≤ b) : P.wt (self.ρ a b h) = self.g b - self.g a
    • mul_ρ (a b c : Q) (h1 : a ≤ b) (h2 : b ≤ c) : P.mul (self.ρ a b h1) (self.ρ b c h2) = some (self.ρ a c ⋯)
    • retL (a b c : Q) (hab : a ⋖ b) (hac : a ≤ c) (h : R) : P.src h = self.v b → P.tgt h = self.v c → P.wt h = self.g c - self.g b → P.mul (self.ρ a b ⋯) h = some (self.ρ a c hac) → b ≤ c
    • retR (a b c : Q) (hab : a ⋖ b) (hcb : c ≤ b) (h : R) : P.src h = self.v c → P.tgt h = self.v a → P.wt h = self.g a - self.g c → P.mul h (self.ρ a b ⋯) = some (self.ρ c b hcb) → c ≤ a
